t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes will always appear in same colour pairs. One will take you to a bright forest and the other to a dark forest. The number of mushrooms constantly change in each forest.  The size, hats and arm positions of the gnomes are not important.

vb_textbox.text: Hi. I found that the bright colour gnomes usually gave the best indication for the higher number of mushrooms. Each pair of gnomes will come in the same colour pairs (orange and brown, green and pink, pink and yellow and blue and purple). I found that the purple gnome gave more mushrooms then the blue, also the yellow gave more then the pink. this doesn't mean that they always gave more mushrooms because sometimes they can change but try to stick with the same gnome between the pairs if that gnome gave you a high number of mushrooms. I did not see a pattern between the gnomes and the positions or hat designs.
